workflow_steps.code_snippet: com.google.common.collect.Multimap<String, Object> partVerify = com.google.common.collect.ArrayListMultimap.create(); partVerify.put("short_part_number", child_part); boolean isEligible = context.checkRecordExists("part", partVerify); if(!isEligible) { throw new EligibilityException("Child part validation failed in master part entity registry."); }
workflow_steps.purpose: Enforce mandatory eligibility rules by verifying the child_part string exists within the master part database table before allowing processing.

workflow_steps.code_snippet: com.google.common.collect.Multimap<String, Object> optionParams = com.google.common.collect.ArrayListMultimap.create(); optionParams.put("child_part", child_part); context.streamDataFromDB("cu_wc_option_child", "byChildPart", optionParams, record -> { optionRevList.add(String.valueOf(record.get("rev_option_no"))); });
workflow_steps.purpose: Stream and collect all registered option revision numbers belonging to the designated component record.

workflow_steps.code_snippet: com.google.common.collect.Multimap<String, Object> bomParams = com.google.common.collect.ArrayListMultimap.create(); bomParams.put("option_assembly_num", optionRevList); context.streamDataFromDB("cu_esn_bom_option_config", "byOptionAssemblyNumbers", bomParams, record -> { java.util.Date bDate = (java.util.Date) record.get("build_date"); if(maxDate[0] == null || bDate.after(maxDate[0])) { maxDate[0] = bDate; } });
workflow_steps.purpose: Extract production histories mapping option revision keys to assembly configuration structures to determine latest build date targets.

workflow_steps.code_snippet: java.util.Calendar cal = java.util.Calendar.getInstance(); cal.setTime(maxDate[0]); int extractedYear = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.YEAR); extractedYearHolder[0] = extractedYear; com.google.common.collect.Multimap<String, Object> volParams = com.google.common.collect.ArrayListMultimap.create(); volParams.put("year", extractedYear); context.streamDataFromDB("cu_bom_config_vol", "byExtractedBuildYear", volParams, record -> { int currentCount = Integer.parseInt(String.valueOf(record.get("esn_count"))); if(currentCount > maxEsnCount[0]) { maxEsnCount[0] = currentCount; selectedConfigNum[0] = String.valueOf(record.get("design_config_num")); } });
